nodes.label: Content API - The Hollow Crown
nodes.rationale: Technical contract for content authors: plain ES modules, no dependencies; DESIGN.md is the narrative/rules source of truth.

nodes.label: Content File Ownership Rule
nodes.rationale: Writers only edit the files they own and never edit engine files; engine changes are requested in the final report, keeping parallel content work conflict-free.

nodes.label: Seeded RNG Streams (g.crng / g.srng / run.rng)
nodes.rationale: All content randomness must go through the game's named streams, never Math.random(), because runs are seeded and resumable.

nodes.label: Global Content ID Prefixing
nodes.rationale: Content ids share one global namespace, so generic hero content is suffixed with the hero id (e.g. strike_witch) to avoid collisions.

nodes.label: Sim Validation (tools/sim.mjs)
nodes.rationale: Content must pass `node tools/sim.mjs --validate-only` and 30 simulated runs per hero with 0 problems/errors. Note: tools/sim.mjs is not present in the repo tree at extraction time.

nodes.label: Card Text Rules
nodes.rationale: Placeholders show live modified numbers; keyword lines are appended by the UI; text kept short because cards are small on a phone.

nodes.label: Status Hooks (defineStatuses)
nodes.rationale: Power cards apply a status to the player whose hooks do the work, so behaviour lives in status hook methods rather than in the card.

nodes.label: Balance Targets
nodes.rationale: Slay-the-Spire-like tuning: player ~70-80 HP, 3 energy, ~5-9 dmg/card early; HP/damage bands per act for normals, elites and bosses.

nodes.label: Event Definition Schema (defineEvents)
nodes.rationale: Choice labels start with a bracketed verb and state honest mechanical outcomes; 60-180 words per page, second person, present tense.

nodes.label: Story Events and Meta Flags
nodes.rationale: Story events are chosen first (<=1 per act) and sequenced by meta flags so beats unlock in order across runs.

nodes.label: Sprites and Painter API (defineSprites)
nodes.rationale: Sprites are drawn with primitives in art pixels; post-processing adds rim light and outline automatically. Enemies face left, heroes face right.

nodes.label: Shared Art Keys (card art, icons, scenes, portraits)
nodes.rationale: Content may only use keys implemented by the art team, decoupling content authors from sprite authors.

nodes.label: The Hollow Crown - Design Bible
nodes.rationale: Dark-fantasy deckbuilding roguelike for mobile landscape; plain JS, no frameworks, offline PWA; ~30 hours to the true ending.

nodes.label: King Aldric IV, the Long King
The Hollow Crown (artifact)
nodes.rationale: The Crown 'holds the hour': it stopped death for its wearer and now holds the hour of Aldric's death, driving the loop.

nodes.label: The Loop (why runs restart)
nodes.rationale: Diegetic justification for roguelike restarts: when an heir dies the Crown takes them back and the world resets to the morning after Ashfall.

nodes.label: Oaths (Knight mechanic)
nodes.rationale: Thematic match: the Knight's arc is about obedience to an oath versus choosing his own.

nodes.label: Masks / Shift (Wren mechanic)
nodes.rationale: Wren has no face and wears carved masks; stances are framed as masks (Wolf, Moth, Owl).

nodes.label: The Pale Mother (Lady Under the Hill)
The Deep Truth
nodes.rationale: Lore is revealed gradually, never all at once.

nodes.label: The Turning of the Year (True ending)
Act 2 - The Weeping Wood and the Drowned Abbey
Hardcore Rules
nodes.rationale: No permanent stat upgrades and seeded per-stream RNG saved after every action prevent save-scumming; only story flags, lore, unlocks and Crown Weight carry over.

nodes.label: Code-Drawn Pixel Art
nodes.rationale: Sprites drawn with primitives at low resolution, auto-outlined and shaded, upscaled nearest-neighbour; no image assets needed.

nodes.label: Mobile Landscape Offline PWA
nodes.rationale: Target platform is mobile in landscape, delivered as an offline PWA with plain JS and no frameworks.

nodes.label: Story Outline - Canonical Beats
nodes.rationale: Single source for story beats; story events live only in src/data/events/story.js and other writers reference beats via flags, never re-implement them.

nodes.label: Mystery Revealed in Fragments
nodes.rationale: Tone: grim, literary, humane; every beat answers one small question and raises another; never dump the whole truth at once.

nodes.label: knows_heart Flag
nodes.rationale: Set by wren_4 and pell_5; gates the Shatter ending.
